root_cause.text: The vulnerability occurs because `kvm_hv_flush_tlb()` used `is_guest_mode(vcpu)` to decide whether to call `translate_nested_gpa()`, but that translation is only valid when nested EPT/NPT (nested page tables) is actually enabled; using `is_guest_mode()` alone can cause incorrect GPA translation or undefined behavior when L2 runs without nested paging.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "Checking is_guest_mode(vcpu) is incorrect, because translate_nested_gpa() is only valid if an L2 guest is running *with nested EPT/NPT enabled*. Instead use the same condition as translate_nested_gpa() itself." The patch changes the condition from `is_guest_mode(vcpu)` to `mmu_is_nested(vcpu)`, which directly mirrors the check inside `translate_nested_gpa()`.
